BEUConnect

BEUConnect releases for Bihar Engineering University students: syllabus, previous year papers, results, rank, attendance, routine and notices.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://pritkr.github.io/beuconnect-fdroid/repo
